brief: Nomura's McElligott says equity vol dynamics are inflecting: VIX is finally outperforming spot even in a mild down tape, straddles that had been too cheap through a month-long vol crush are now over-realizing, with SPX's straddle near 30bps. A second driver: AI-linked names in structured note baskets are knocking out amid the momentum rally, which removes the flow that made dealers buy vol on up days and sell vol on down days. Nomura reasons this could end the recent positive spot-vol correlation regime and revert to the traditional negative correlation, while also stripping dealers of gap hedges, pushing them to reach for short-dated wings and vol-of-vol. Separately, post-PPI Core PCE repricing drove an 80bp SPX futures drop and a de-gross with shorts outperforming longs, as Fed terminal-rate pricing rose (~4.45% by 4Q27) on fiscal dominance/AI-debt crowding out and an ~8.5% Atlanta Fed nominal GDP read, plus a rates selloff tied to China rebuilding crude reserves with Iran. Nomura flags crowded short-bond/STIRS carry and momentum trades, built on low realized vol, as vulnerable to mechanical deleveraging if vol spikes.
